title: Frontend Developer
text:
Frontend Developer

About the role
We are building a design system and need an engineer who cares about accessibility and performance.

Requirements
- Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills; 3+ years with React
- Must have solid HTML5 and CSS3, including responsive design
- Experience consuming REST APIs and using Git
- Excellent communication and teamwork

Nice to have
- Node.js or GraphQL experience
- Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD
- Jest or other unit testing tools is a bonus

title: Backend Engineer
text:
Backend Engineer

You will design services in Node.js and C# (.NET) backed by PostgreSQL.

Required:
- Proficiency in C#, .NET and SQL
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS
- Strong understanding of data structures and REST APIs
- Problem solving and leadership

Preferred:
- C++ for performance-critical modules
- GraphQL, MongoDB
